summary: Advanced Biomed Inc. filed an 8-K on June 30, 2026, reporting its entry into a Share Purchase Agreement to sell 100% of its Taiwan subsidiary to Miaozhu Zhao, an unrelated third party, for $490,000 in cash. The subsidiary conducts biomedical R&D including the A+PerfusC platform. The transaction is expected to close within three months, with the company retaining its AI-focused operations. No board recommendation, advisor, or premium is disclosed. The sale appears to be a strategic shift toward AI. Watch for closing conditions and regulatory clearance; risk-arb is minimal given the small size.
